visualCharacteristics: Narrow rail list, small thumbnail left, title right

contentPattern.rows: One row per card, plus an optional final row holding only a link (e.g. 'More Recipes' or 'Load More')

usage.description: Compact thumbnail + title list in the right rail (What's Cooking, Recently on TV).

reuseGuidance: Use in narrow sidebar columns. Keep titles short; a final single-link row renders as a trailing action under the list.
